_doc: Rebuilt from Emberveil (~/claude/emberveil data/items.json, uniques.json, src/game/{items,sets,legendaryEffects,recipes}.js, drop-tables.json). Dead base keys in the original drop tables were remapped (axe→battleaxe, mace→iron_mace, gloves→light_gauntlets, boots→light_boots, amulet→necklace, helmet→heavy_helm). The 40 extended affixes (dormant in the original) are wired in here behind `extended:true`. Uniques with no boss source drop through the set/unique roll in generateLoot.

uniques.name: Emberheart Pendant
uniques.lore: Forged in the first Ember-Breach, it pulses with trapped wildfire.

uniques.name: Thornblade
uniques.lore: Cut from the ancient Thornwood. The forest remembers every wound.

uniques.name: Sentinel's Gaze
uniques.lore: The Sentinel who wore this helmed the final wall. It was never breached.

uniques.name: Truthseeker
uniques.lore: "Every question is already answered — you need only cast the right spell."

uniques.name: Lava Titan's Mantle
uniques.lore: Plate forged from cooled magma. Each blow threatens to reignite it.

uniques.name: Magma Scepter
uniques.lore: Still warm. Always warm.

uniques.name: Ashen Kite Shield
uniques.lore: The ash sigil on its face was drawn in the last days of the Ember Wars.

uniques.name: Dune Runner's Shortbow
uniques.lore: Carved from desert ironwood. You hear the dunes shift when you draw.

uniques.name: Malgrath's Soulbrand
uniques.lore: Malgrath branded this staff with his true name. It knows your weakness.

uniques.name: Warlord's Insignia
uniques.lore: Passed between generals for three centuries. Still smells of blood.

uniques.name: Deadwalker's Greaves
uniques.lore: The dead do not tire. These boots share that secret.

uniques.name: Shadowweave Cloak
uniques.lore: "Wear the shadow; become the wound."

uniques.name: Sovereign's Eye
uniques.lore: Plucked from the Sovereign's crown. It still judges everything it sees.

uniques.name: Voidbinder
uniques.lore: It slips between realities. You are never sure where the blade really is.

uniques.name: Unraveler's Sigil
uniques.lore: The Unraveler used this to pull threads from the fabric of being.

uniques.name: Gauntlets of the Void
uniques.lore: Everything they touch loses something. No one knows what.

uniques.name: The Architect's Blueprint
uniques.lore: The Architect drew every possibility before choosing one. This ring holds the rest.

uniques.name: Staff of the Primordial
uniques.lore: Before there was a world, there was this. Then: everything else.

uniques.name: Plate of Creation
uniques.lore: The first thing the Architect ever made. Still flawless.

uniques.name: Voidreaver Bow
uniques.lore: Its arrows don't travel through space. They create a wound and follow.

uniques.name: Greatsword of the Last King
uniques.lore: He died alone on the Last Throne. The sword keeps fighting.

uniques.name: Necklace of the Final Seal
uniques.lore: The seal on this pendant has held for a thousand years. It will hold one more day.

uniques.name: Dragon-King's Headguard
uniques.lore: Bahamorth wore this at the height of his rule. It is heavier than it looks.

uniques.name: Ancient Dragon Scale
uniques.lore: Scales shed only once, at the end of an Age. You hold the last one.

legendaryEffects.mage_missile_aoe: Missile-type spells bounce to a second enemy for 60% damage.
legendaryEffects.low_mana_shockwave: Casting below 25% MP releases an arcane shockwave (15 + INT/2) to all enemies.
legendaryEffects.kill_party_heal: Killing blows heal every ally for 10% of the victim's max HP.
legendaryEffects.cheat_death_once: Once per combat, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP.
legendaryEffects.burn_extend: Burns you apply last 2 rounds longer.
legendaryEffects.critical_armorpen: Critical hits ignore 30% of the target's armor next round.
legendaryEffects.rally_on_kill: Killing blows Rally the whole party.
legendaryEffects.echo_cast: 25% chance a spell echoes for 50% damage.
legendaryEffects.dragon_fury_breath: Killing blows breathe fire on all other enemies (20 + STR) and Burn them.

revival_flask.name: Revival Flask
revival_flask.desc: Revives a fallen ally at 25% max HP with damage immunity until their next action.

group_tonic.name: Group Tonic
group_tonic.desc: Restores 25 HP to all living allies.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.desc: Removes Poison and Bleed from one ally.
